zhConsts.TXT_LEAVE: 没人能随随便便离开像素地牢。
zhConsts.TXT_NEW_LEVEL: 欢迎来到等级 %d！你现在更健壮、也更专注。命中敌人与闪避攻击都变得更容易了。
zhConsts.TXT_LOCKED_CHEST: 这个箱子上锁了，你没有匹配的钥匙

enConsts.TXT_LEAVE: One does not simply leave Pixel Dungeon.
enConsts.TXT_NEW_LEVEL: Welcome to level %d! Now you are healthier and more focused. It's easier for you to hit enemies and dodge their attacks.
enConsts.TXT_LOCKED_CHEST: This chest is locked and you don't have matching key
enConsts.TXT_LOCKED_DOOR: You don't have a matching key

en: warrior
zh: 勇士

en: mage
zh: 法师

en: rogue
zh: 盗贼

en: huntress
zh: 女猎手

en: Warriors start with 11 points of Strength.
Warriors start with a unique short sword. This sword can be later "reforged" to upgrade another melee weapon.
Warriors are less proficient with missile weapons.
Any piece of food restores some health when eaten.
Potions of Strength are identified from the beginning.
zh: 勇士初始拥有 11 点力量。
勇士开局自带一把独特的短剑。这把剑日后可以「重铸」，用来升级另一把近战武器。
勇士不擅长投掷武器。
勇士吃下任何食物都会回复一些生命。
力量药水从一开始就是已鉴定状态。

en: Mages start with a unique Wand of Magic Missile. This wand can be later "disenchanted" to upgrade another wand.
Mages recharge their wands faster.
When eaten, any piece of food restores 1 charge for all wands in the inventory.
Mages can use wands as a melee weapon.
Scrolls of Identify are identified from the beginning.
zh: 法师开局自带一支独特的魔法飞弹法杖。这支法杖日后可以「分解附魔」，用来升级另一支法杖。
法师的法杖充能速度更快。
法师吃下任意食物时，会为背包中所有法杖各恢复 1 点充能。
法师可以把法杖当作近战武器使用。
鉴定卷轴从一开始就是已鉴定状态。

en: Rogues start with a Ring of Shadows+1.
Rogues identify a type of a ring on equipping it.
Rogues are proficient with light armor, dodging better while wearing one.
Rogues are proficient in detecting hidden doors and traps.
Rogues can go without food longer.
Scrolls of Magic Mapping are identified from the beginning.
zh: 盗贼开局自带一枚暗影之戒+1。
盗贼在装备戒指时即可鉴定其类型。
盗贼精通轻甲，穿着轻甲时闪避更高。
盗贼擅长发现暗门与陷阱。
盗贼能更久地不吃东西。
魔法地图卷轴从一开始就是已鉴定状态。

en: Huntresses start with 15 points of Health.
Huntresses start with a unique upgradeable boomerang.
Huntresses are proficient with missile weapons and get a damage bonus for excessive strength when using them.
Huntresses gain more health from dewdrops.
Huntresses sense neighbouring monsters even if they are hidden behind obstacles.
zh: 女猎手初始拥有 15 点生命。
女猎手开局自带一把独特的可升级回旋镖。
女猎手精通投掷武器，力量过剩时还会获得额外伤害加成。
女猎手从露水中获得更多生命回复。
女猎手能感知邻近的怪物，即使它们躲在障碍物后面。

en: gladiator
A successful attack with a melee weapon allows the _Gladiator_ to start a combo,
in which every next successful hit inflicts more damage.
zh: 角斗士
用近战武器成功命中后，_角斗士_可以开始连击，此后每一次成功命中都会造成更高的伤害。

en: berserker
When severely wounded, the _Berserker_ enters a state of wild fury
significantly increasing his damage output.
zh: 狂战士
身受重伤时，_狂战士_会进入狂怒状态，大幅提升伤害输出。

en: warlock
After killing an enemy the _Warlock_ consumes its soul.
It heals his wounds and satisfies his hunger.
zh: 术士
击杀敌人后，_术士_会吞噬其灵魂，以此治愈伤口并缓解饥饿。

en: battlemage
When fighting with a wand in his hands, the _Battlemage_ inflicts additional damage depending
on the current number of charges. Every successful hit restores 1 charge to this wand.
zh: 战斗法师
手持法杖作战时，_战斗法师_会根据当前充能数造成额外伤害。每次成功命中都会为这支法杖恢复 1 点充能。

en: assassin
When performing a surprise attack, the _Assassin_ inflicts additional damage to his target.
zh: 刺客
发动偷袭时，_刺客_会对目标造成额外伤害。

en: freerunner
The _Freerunner_ can move almost twice faster, than most of the monsters. When he
is running, the Freerunner is much harder to hit. For that he must be unencumbered and not starving.
zh: 疾行者
_疾行者_的移动速度几乎是大多数怪物的两倍。奔跑时他更难被击中。为此他必须轻装，且不能处于饥饿状态。

en: sniper
_Snipers_ are able to detect weak points in an enemy's armor,
effectively ignoring it when using a missile weapon.
zh: 狙击手
_狙击手_能发现敌人护甲上的弱点，使用投掷武器时可有效无视护甲。

en: warden
Having a strong connection with forces of nature gives _Wardens_ an ability to gather dewdrops and
seeds from plants. Also trampling a high grass grants them a temporary armor buff.
zh: 守望者
与大自然之力的紧密联系让_守望者_能够从植物上采集露水与种子。此外，踩倒高草会赋予她们一个临时护甲增益。

items.zhDesc: 耶诺之护符是已知最强大的神器，其来源不明。据说，只要主人的意志足够坚定，能「说服」它，这枚护符就能实现任何愿望。
items.enDesc: The Amulet of Yendor is the most powerful known artifact of unknown origin. It is said that the amulet is able to fulfil any wish if its owner's will-power is strong enough to "persuade" it to do it.

items.zhDesc: 这枚古老的不朽象征赋予你死而复生的能力。复活时，所有未装备的物品都会遗失。
items.enDesc: The ancient symbol of immortality grants an ability to return to life after death. Upon resurrection all non-equipped items are lost.

zhConsts.TXT_EQUIP_CURSED: 你的%s紧紧勒住你，痛得你龇牙咧嘴
zhConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: 你对自己的%s已经足够熟悉，可以鉴定它了。它是%s。
zhConsts.TXT_INCOMPATIBLE: 不同种类魔法的相互作用抹去了这件护甲上的印记！

enConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: you are now familiar enough with your %s to identify it. It is %s.
enConsts.TXT_INCOMPATIBLE: Interaction of different types of magic has erased the glyph on this armor!

items.zhDesc: 用这套小工具和材料，任何人都能把一件护甲改造成「专属护甲」。它会保留原护甲的全部属性，还会根据穿戴者的职业赋予一项特殊能力。裁缝、皮革加工或锻造的技能一概不需要。
items.enDesc: Using this kit of small tools and materials anybody can transform any armor into an "epic armor", which will keep all properties of the original armor, but will also provide its wearer a special ability depending on his class. No skills in tailoring, leatherworking or blacksmithing are required.

zhConsts.TXT_SELECT_ARMOR: 选择一件护甲进行改造
zhConsts.TXT_UPGRADED: 你用护甲改造套件升级了你的%s

enConsts.TXT_UPGRADED: you applied the armor kit to upgrade your %s

items.zhDesc: 这把战斧巨大的钢制斧头，让每一次挥砍都力道十足。
items.enDesc: The enormous steel head of this battle axe puts considerable heft behind each stroke.

items.zhDesc: 这是一颗体积不大的炸弹，里面装满了黑火药。方便的是，它被扔出去时引信会自动点燃。
items.enDesc: This is a relatively small bomb, filled with black powder. Conveniently, its fuse is lit automatically when the bomb is thrown.

items.zhDesc: 这种扁平弯曲的木制投掷物掷向敌人后，会自行飞回投掷者手中。
items.enDesc: Thrown to the enemy this flat curved wooden missile will return to the hands of its thrower.

items.zhDesc: 看起来是块像样的肉排。
items.enDesc: It looks like a decent steak.

items.zhDesc: 这东西看起来酷毙了！
items.enDesc: The thing looks awesome!

zhConsts.TXT_NOT_EQUIPPED: 你必须穿着这件护甲才能使用它的特殊能力！

enConsts.TXT_NOT_EQUIPPED: You need to be wearing this armor to use its special power!

items.zhDesc: 这件轻便的护甲只能提供最基础的防护。
items.enDesc: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.

items.zhDesc: 这团尸尘外表与普通灰尘没什么两样。但你就是知道，最好尽快把它处理掉。
items.enDesc: The ball of corpse dust doesn't differ outwardly from a regular dust ball. However, you know somehow that it's better to get rid of it as soon as possible.

items.zhDesc: 这些小小的邪恶飞镖伤害不高，却能让目标麻痹，在一段时间内无助地动弹不得。
items.enDesc: These little evil darts don't do much damage but they can paralyze the target leaving it helpless and motionless for some time.

items.zhDesc: 一把朴素的铁质匕首，木柄已经磨得发亮。
items.enDesc: A simple iron dagger with a well worn wooden handle.

items.zhDesc: 这种金属之所以叫暗金，不是因为颜色（它跟普通黄金毫无区别），而是因为它在日光下会熔化，因此在地面上毫无用处。
items.enDesc: This metal is called dark not because of its color (it doesn't differ from the normal gold), but because it melts under the daylight, making it useless on the surface.

items.zhDesc: 这些简单的金属尖刺经过配重，能笔直飞行，手腕一抖便可刺中猎物。
items.enDesc: These simple metal spikes are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist.

items.zhDesc: 你可以把多余的露水装进这个小瓶，留着以后喝。如果瓶子是满的，在生死关头露水会被自动喝下。
items.enDesc: You can store excess dew in this tiny vessel for drinking it later. If the vial is full, in a moment of deadly peril the dew will be consumed automatically.

zhConsts.TXT_AUTO_DRINK: 露水瓶被喝空，治愈了你的伤口。
zhConsts.TXT_COLLECTED: 你收集了一滴露水装进露水瓶。

enConsts.TXT_AUTO_DRINK: The dew vial was emptied to heal your wounds.
enConsts.TXT_COLLECTED: You collected a dewdrop into your dew vial.

items.zhDesc: 一滴清澈透明的露水。
items.enDesc: A crystal clear dewdrop.

items.zhDesc: 玫瑰早就干枯了，但不知怎么，花瓣一片都没掉。
items.enDesc: The rose has dried long ago, but it has kept all its petals somehow.

items.zhDesc: 许多矮人，以及他们造出的一些大型造物，都随身带着这种用途不明的小金属片。也许是首饰，也许是某种身份证件。矮人真是奇怪的家伙。
items.enDesc: Many dwarves and some of their larger creations carry these small pieces of metal of unknown purpose. Maybe they are jewelry or maybe some kind of ID. Dwarves are strange folk.

items.zhDesc: 没什么特别的：肉干、几块饼干之类的东西。
items.enDesc: Nothing fancy here: dried meat, some biscuits - things like that.

items.zhDesc: 这是一块冻硬的生肉。唯一的吃法是切下薄薄的薄片。这样吃意外的不错。
items.enDesc: It's a piece of frozen raw meat. The only way to eat it is by cutting thin slices of it. And this way it's suprisingly good.

items.zhDesc: 一种长柄兵器，在长杆末端装上剑刃。
items.enDesc: A polearm consisting of a sword blade on the end of a pole.

zhConsts.TXT_COLLECT: 收集金币，以后好在商店里花掉。

enConsts.TXT_COLLECT: Collect gold coins to spend them later in a shop.

items.zhDesc: 这把金钥匙的齿纹细密而精巧。也许它能打开某个箱子上的锁？
items.enDesc: The notches on this golden key are tiny and intricate. Maybe it can open some chest lock?

items.zhDesc: 这个小蜜罐里蜂蜜不多，但里面住着一只金色蜜蜂，而且它并不想离开。
items.enDesc: There is not much honey in this small honeypot, but there is a golden bee there and it doesn't want to leave it.

items.zhDesc: 穿上这件斗篷的女猎手能唤出一扇扇形的光刃。每一片光刃都会锁定女猎手视野中的一名敌人，造成的伤害取决于她当前装备的近战武器。
items.enDesc: A huntress in such cloak can create a fan of spectral blades. Each of these blades will target a single enemy in the huntress's field of view, inflicting damage depending on her currently equipped melee weapon.

zhConsts.TXT_NOT_HUNTRESS: 只有女猎手能使用这件护甲！

enConsts.TXT_NOT_HUNTRESS: Only huntresses can use this armor!

items.zhDesc: 每支飞镖的尖刺用来把它钉在目标身上，同时绑在镖身上的不稳定化合物会爆发出耀眼的火焰。
items.enDesc: The spike on each of these darts is designed to pin it to its target while the unstable compounds strapped to its length burst into brilliant flames.

zhConsts.TXT_WARNING: 你真的要取消这次卷轴使用吗？无论如何它都会被消耗掉。

enConsts.TXT_WARNING: Do you really want to cancel this scroll usage? It will be consumed anyway.

zhConsts.TXT_FROM_DEPTH: 来自第 %d 层的铁钥匙

zhConsts.TXT_PACK_FULL: 你的背包太满了，装不下%s
zhConsts.TXT_BROKEN: 由于频繁使用，你的%s已经损坏。
zhConsts.TXT_GONNA_BREAK: 由于频繁使用，你的%s很快就要坏了。

enConsts.TXT_PACK_FULL: Your pack is too full for the %s
enConsts.TXT_BROKEN: Because of frequent use, your %s has broken.
enConsts.TXT_GONNA_BREAK: Because of frequent use, your %s is going to break soon.

items.zhDesc: 这根金属长杆经过配重，使尖端在飞行途中始终朝前。
items.enDesc: This length of metal is weighted to keep the spike at its tip foremost as it sails through the air.

items.zhDesc: 这是一枚铜制钥匙环，让你把钥匙和其余物品分开存放。
items.enDesc: This is a copper key ring, that lets you keep all your keys separately from the rest of your belongings.

enConsts.TXT_EQUIP_CURSED: you wince as your grip involuntarily tightens around your %s

items.zhDesc: 一块贴合指关节形状的铁块。
items.enDesc: A piece of iron shaped to fit around the knuckles.

items.zhDesc: 用鞣制过的怪物皮革制成的护甲。不如布甲轻便，但防护更好。
items.enDesc: Armor made from tanned monster hide. Not as light as cloth armor but provides better protection.

items.zhDesc: 劳埃德信标是一件精巧的魔法装置，能让你回到曾经去过的地方。
items.enDesc: {TXT_INFO}{returnDepth}{Utils.format}{TXT_SET}{returnDepth}

zhConsts.TXT_PREVENTING: 此地强大的魔力场让你无法使用劳埃德信标！
zhConsts.TXT_CREATURES: 邻近生物的心灵力场让你此刻无法使用劳埃德信标。
zhConsts.TXT_RETURN: 劳埃德信标已成功设置在你当前的位置，现在你可以随时回到这里。
zhConsts.TXT_INFO: 劳埃德信标是一件精巧的魔法装置，能让你回到一个你已经去过的地方。
zhConsts.TXT_SET: 这个信标被设置在像素地牢第 %d 层的某处。

enConsts.TXT_PREVENTING: Strong magic aura of this place prevents you from using the lloyd's beacon!
enConsts.TXT_CREATURES: Psychic aura of neighbouring creatures doesn't allow you to use the lloyd's beacon at this moment.
enConsts.TXT_RETURN: The lloyd's beacon is successfully set at your current location, now you can return here anytime.
enConsts.TXT_INFO: Lloyd's beacon is an intricate magic device, that allows you to return to a place you have already been.
enConsts.TXT_SET: This beacon was set somewhere on the level %d of Pixel Dungeon.

items.zhDesc: 这柄又高又重的剑刃把全部重量压进每一次劈砍，能造成重伤。
items.enDesc: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every cut.

items.zhDesc: 这把武器的铁质锤头能造成相当可观的伤害。
items.enDesc: The iron head of this weapon inflicts substantial damage.

items.zhDesc: 穿上这件华美的长袍，法师可以施展「熔岩大地」法术：视野内的所有敌人都会被点燃，同时无法移动。
items.enDesc: Wearing this gorgeous robe, a mage can cast a spell of molten earth: all the enemies in his field of view will be set on fire and unable to move at the same time.

zhConsts.TXT_NOT_MAGE: 只有法师能使用这件护甲！

enConsts.TXT_NOT_MAGE: Only mages can use this armor!

items.zhDesc: 互相扣合的金属环组成了一套坚韧而灵活的护甲。
items.enDesc: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.

zhConsts.TXT_YES: 是的，我清楚自己在做什么
zhConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE: 你真的要把它当作近战武器来装备吗？

enConsts.TXT_YES: Yes, I know what I'm doing
enConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE: Do you really want to equip it as a melee weapon?

items.zhDesc: 吃不吃随你，后果自负！
items.enDesc: Eat at your own risk!

items.zhDesc: 看起来跟标准口粮一模一样，只是小了点。
items.enDesc: It looks exactly like a standard ration of food but smaller.

items.zhDesc: 这是正宗的康沃尔馅饼，传统的牛肉加土豆馅。
items.enDesc: This is authentic Cornish pasty with traditional filling of beef and potato.

items.zhDesc: 你几乎看不见这尾在空气中半透明的小鱼。一旦进入水里，它就会彻底隐形。
items.enDesc: You can barely see this tiny translucent fish in the air. In the water it becomes effectively invisible.

items.zhDesc: 这是一把又大又结实的破岩工具。大概也能当武器使。
items.enDesc: This is a large and sturdy tool for breaking rocks. Probably it can be used as a weapon.

zhConsts.TXT_NO_VEIN: 你附近没有可以开采的暗金矿脉

enConsts.TXT_NO_VEIN: There is no dark gold vein near you to mine

items.zhDesc: 巨大的金属板拼接成一整套护甲，为任何强壮到能承受它惊人重量的冒险者提供无可比拟的防护。
items.enDesc: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}{desc}这只小瓶里装着不停打旋的{color}液体。谁知道喝下去或者扔出去会发生什么？
items.enDesc: {isKnown}{desc}This flask contains a swirling {color} liquid. Who knows what it will do when drunk or thrown?

zhConsts.TXT_YES: 是的，我清楚自己在做什么
zhConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE_DRINK: 你确定要喝下它吗？大多数情况下，这种药水应该扔向敌人才对。
zhConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE_THROW: 你确定要扔掉它吗？大多数情况下，喝下它才是明智之举。

enConsts.TXT_YES: Yes, I know what I'm doing
enConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE_DRINK: Are you sure you want to drink it? In most cases you should throw such potions at your enemies.
enConsts.TXT_R_U_SURE_THROW: Are you sure you want to throw it? In most cases it makes sense to drink it.

items.zhDesc: 无数场战斗积淀的历练被浓缩成液体，喝下后立即提升一个经验等级。
items.enDesc: The storied experiences of multitudes of battles reduced to liquid form, this draught will instantly raise your experience level.

items.zhDesc: 这种化学物质一旦接触空气就会蒸发成冰霜云团，任何碰到它的生物都会被冻在原地，无法行动也无法移动。
items.enDesc: Upon exposure to open air, this chemical will evaporate into a freezing cloud, causing any creature that contacts it to be frozen in place, unable to act and move.

items.zhDesc: 一瓶能立刻让你恢复满生命值并解除中毒的药剂。
items.enDesc: An elixir that will instantly return you to full health and cure poison.

items.zhDesc: 喝下后你会暂时隐形，敌人将看不见你。攻击敌人，或在敌人眼前使用法杖、卷轴，都会解除这个效果。
items.enDesc: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. While invisible, enemies will be unable to see you. Attacking an enemy, as well as using a wand or a scroll before enemy's eyes, will dispel the effect.

items.zhDesc: 喝下这种奇特的液体会让你悬浮在空中，可以毫不费力地飘过陷阱。不过火焰和毒气弥漫在空气中，飘着也躲不开。
items.enDesc: Drinking this curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air, able to drift effortlessly over traps. Flames and gases fill the air, however, and cannot be bypassed while airborne.

items.zhDesc: 瓶里装着不稳定的化合物，一接触空气就会猛烈燃烧起来。
items.enDesc: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air.

items.zhDesc: 这瓶强劲的液体会流遍你的肌肉，永久提升 1 点力量和 5 点生命上限。
items.enDesc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point and health by five points.

items.zhDesc: 喝下之后，你的精神会与远处生物的心灵信号同步，让你能隔着墙壁感知生命存在。它还能让你看穿附近的墙壁和门。
items.enDesc: After drinking this, your mind will become attuned to the psychic signature of distant creatures, enabling you to sense biological presences through walls. Also this potion will permit you to see through nearby walls and doors.

items.zhDesc: 瓶中的液体接触空气后会汽化成麻木的黄色烟雾。吸入烟雾的人会立刻麻痹，在烟雾散去后的一段时间里仍无法移动。可以把它扔向远处的敌人，让他们笼罩在气体里。
items.enDesc: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing yellow haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.

items.zhDesc: 这种试剂会迅速中和作用范围内的所有有害气体。喝下它能让你在一段时间内对此类气体免疫。
items.enDesc: This reagent will quickly neutralize all harmful gases in the area of effect. Drinking it will give you a temporary immunity to such gases.

zhConsts.TXT_FRESHNESS: 你感到空气中有一种异样的清新。
zhConsts.TXT_NO_SMELL: 你再也闻不到任何气味了！

enConsts.TXT_FRESHNESS: You feel uncommon freshness in the air.

items.zhDesc: 这瓶强劲的液体会流遍你的肌肉，永久提升 1 点力量。
items.enDesc: This powerful liquid will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.

items.zhDesc: 打开或摔碎这个加压玻璃瓶，里面的东西会炸成一片致命的绿色毒云。你也可以选择把它扔向远处的敌人，而不是拿在手里开瓶。
items.enDesc: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of toxic green gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.

items.zhDesc: 一根硬木长杖，两端包着铁箍。
items.enDesc: A staff of hardwood, its ends are shod with iron.

items.zhDesc: 这本来会是个不错的狩猎战利品，可惜太臭了，挂不到墙上去。
items.enDesc: It could be a nice hunting trophy, but it smells too bad to place it on a wall.

items.zhDesc: {desc}  {name}正戴在你的手指上{cursed}，由于它被诅咒，你无力将它取下。
items.enDesc:
{desc}

The {name} is on your finger{cursed}, and because it is cursed, you are powerless to remove it..

zhConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: 你对自己的%s已经足够熟悉，可以鉴定它了。它是%s。
zhConsts.TXT_UNEQUIP_MESSAGE: 你同时只能戴两枚戒指。请取下一枚已装备的戒指。

enConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: you are now familiar enough with your %s to identify it. It is %s.
enConsts.TXT_UNEQUIP_MESSAGE: You can only wear two rings at a time. Unequip one of your equipped rings.

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指提高你命中敌人的概率。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}This ring increases your chance to hit the enemy.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}戴上这枚戒指，佩戴者无需花时间搜索就能察觉隐藏的秘密——陷阱与暗门。劣化的侦测之戒会让你的感官迟钝，即便主动搜索也更难发现秘密。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}Wearing this ring will allow the wearer to notice hidden secrets - traps and secret doors - without taking time to search. Degraded rings of detection will dull your senses, making it harder to notice secrets even when actively searching for them.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指提供对不同元素的抗性，比如火焰、电流、毒气等等，同时缩短负面效果的持续时间。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}This ring provides resistance to different elements, such as fire, electricity, gases etc. Also it decreases duration of negative effects.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指提高你躲开敌人攻击的概率。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}This ring increases your chance to dodge enemy attack.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}事实上这枚戒指没有任何魔法效果，但它能向店主和商贩表明：戒指的主人属于盗贼公会。通常他们很乐意给点折扣，换取临时的「免骚扰」保证。升级这枚戒指不会带来任何额外加成。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}In fact this ring doesn't provide any magic effect, but it demonstrates to shopkeepers and vendors, that the owner of the ring is a member of The Thieves' Guild. Usually they are glad to give a discount in exchange for temporary immunity guarantee. Upgrading this ring won't give any additional bonuses.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指加快佩戴者的时间流速，让所有动作都变得快上一点。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}This ring accelerates the wearer's flow of time, allowing one to perform all actions a little faster.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指提高你从踩倒的草丛中收集露水和种子的概率。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}This ring increases your chance to gather dew and seeds from trampled grass.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}这枚戒指增强身体的再生能力，让你以更快的速度恢复损失的生命。劣化的戒指会降低甚至停止你的自然恢复。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}This ring increases the body's regenerative properties, allowing one to recover lost health at an accelerated rate. Degraded rings will decrease or even halt one's natural regeneration.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}在这枚戒指辐射出的能量场中，你的法杖会变得更强大。劣化的能量之戒反而会削弱你的法杖。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}Your wands will become more powerful in the energy field that radiates from this ring. Degraded rings of power will instead weaken your wands.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}戴上这枚戒指，你能更久地不吃东西。劣化的饱腹之戒会产生相反的效果。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}Wearing this ring you can go without food longer. Degraded rings of satiety will cause the opposite effect.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}戴上这枚戒指，敌人更不容易注意到你。劣化的暗影之戒反而会惊动本不会发现你的敌人。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}Enemies will be less likely to notice you if you wear this ring. Degraded rings of shadows will alert enemies who might otherwise not have noticed your presence.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}虽然这枚戒指并没有真正的尖刺，但攻击你的敌人会按它造成伤害的一部分反伤自身。升级这枚戒指不会带来任何额外加成。{super.desc}
items.enDesc: {isKnown}Though this ring doesn't provide real thorns, an enemy that attacks you will itself be wounded by a fraction of the damage that it inflicts. Upgrading this ring won't give any additional bonuses.{super.desc}

items.zhDesc: 穿着这件深色夜行衣，盗贼可以施展被称为「烟雾弹」的技巧（虽然并不真的用到炸药）：他会致盲所有能看见他的敌人，然后跳向一旁。
items.enDesc: Wearing this dark garb, a rogue can perform a trick, that is called "smoke bomb" (though no real explosives are used): he blinds enemies who could see him and jumps aside.

zhConsts.TXT_FOV: 你只能跳到视野内的空地上
zhConsts.TXT_NOT_ROGUE: 只有盗贼能使用这件护甲！

enConsts.TXT_FOV: You can only jump to an empty location in your field of view
enConsts.TXT_NOT_ROGUE: Only rogues can use this armor!

items.zhDesc: 缝在皮背心上的金属鳞片，造就了一件既灵活又能防身的护甲。
items.enDesc: The metal scales sewn onto a leather vest create a flexible, yet protective armor.

items.zhDesc: {isKnown}{desc}这张羊皮纸上写满了无法解读的文字，标题处画着{rune}符文。谁知道大声念出来会发生什么？
items.enDesc: {isKnown}{desc}This parchment is covered with indecipherable writing, and bears a title of rune {rune}. Who knows what it will do when read aloud?

zhConsts.TXT_BLINDED: 失明时你无法阅读卷轴

enConsts.TXT_BLINDED: You can't read a scroll while blinded

items.zhDesc: 你可以把任意数量的卷轴放进这个筒状容器。它节省背包空间，还能保护卷轴不被火烧毁。
items.enDesc: You can place any number of scrolls into this tubular container. It saves room in your backpack and protects scrolls from fire.

items.zhDesc: 大声念出后，这张卷轴会爆发出一声挑衅的怒吼，惊醒所有怪物，让它们注意到朗读者的位置。
items.enDesc: When read aloud, this scroll will unleash a challenging roar that will awaken all monsters and alert them to the reader's location.

items.zhDesc: 这张卷轴能为一把武器或一件护甲随机附上一条附魔，赋予它特殊的能力。
items.enDesc: This scroll is able to imbue a weapon or an armor with a random enchantment, granting it a special power.

zhConsts.TXT_GLOWS: 你的%s在黑暗中发出微光

items.zhDesc: 永久揭示一件物品的全部秘密。
items.enDesc: Permanently reveals all of the secrets of a single item.

items.zhDesc: 一段舒缓的旋律会让你视野中的所有生物陷入沉睡，给你逃跑或偷袭的机会。
items.enDesc: A soothing melody will put all creatures in your field of view into a deep sleep, giving you a chance to flee or make a surprise attack on them.

items.zhDesc: 念出这张卷轴时，一幅清晰无比的图像会刻进你的记忆，让你知晓本层的精确布局并发现所有隐藏的秘密。物品与生物的位置仍然未知。
items.enDesc: When this scroll is read, an image of crystal clarity will be etched into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all hidden secrets. The locations of items and creatures will remain unknown.

zhConsts.TXT_LAYOUT: 你现在已经掌握了本层的布局。

enConsts.TXT_LAYOUT: You are now aware of the level layout.

items.zhDesc: 这张卷轴上的咒语会创造出朗读者的幻影分身，替他追击敌人。
items.enDesc: The incantation on this scroll will create illusionary twins of the reader, which will chase his enemies.

items.zhDesc: 这张卷轴蕴含着破坏性的能量，可以通过心灵引导，对视野内的所有生物造成巨大伤害。伴随的闪光还会暂时致盲作用范围内的所有人，包括朗读卷轴的人自己。
items.enDesc: This scroll contains destructive energy, that can be psionically channeled to inflict a massive damage to all creatures within a field of view. An accompanying flash of light will temporarily blind everybody in the area of effect including the reader of the scroll.

items.zhDesc: 这张羊皮纸中封存的原始魔力一旦释放，会把朗读者的所有法杖充能至满。
items.enDesc: The raw magical power bound up in this parchment will, when released, recharge all of the reader's wands to full power.

items.zhDesc: 这张卷轴上的咒语会立刻剥离朗读者的武器、护甲、戒指和随身物品上一切可能妨碍其卸下的邪恶诅咒。
items.enDesc: The incantation on this scroll will instantly strip from the reader's weapon, armor, rings and carried items any evil enchantments that might prevent the wearer from removing them.

zhConsts.TXT_PROCCED: 你的背包泛起一层净化的光，一股邪恶的能量随之消散。
zhConsts.TXT_NOT_PROCCED: 你的背包泛起一层净化的光，但什么也没有发生。

enConsts.TXT_PROCCED: Your pack glows with a cleansing light, and a malevolent energy disperses.
enConsts.TXT_NOT_PROCCED: Your pack glows with a cleansing light, but nothing happens.

items.zhDesc: 羊皮纸上的法术会把朗读者立刻送到本地牢层的某个随机位置。它能用来逃离险境，但运气不好的话，可能反而落进更危险的地方。
items.enDesc: The spell on this parchment instantly transports the reader to a random location on the dungeon level. It can be used to escape a dangerous situation, but the unlucky reader might find himself in an even more dangerous place.

zhConsts.TXT_TELEPORTED: 一眨眼之间，你被传送到了本层的另一处。
zhConsts.TXT_NO_TELEPORT: 此处强大的魔力场让你无法传送！

enConsts.TXT_TELEPORTED: In a blink of an eye you were teleported to another location of the level.
enConsts.TXT_NO_TELEPORT: Strong magic aura of this place prevents you from teleporting!

items.zhDesc: 一道红光会让视野中的所有生物陷入极度恐惧，转身逃跑。攻击正在逃跑的敌人会解除这个效果。
items.enDesc: A flash of red light will overwhelm all creatures in your field of view with terror, and they will turn and flee. Attacking a fleeing enemy will dispel the effect.

items.zhDesc: 这张卷轴能升级一件物品，提升它的品质。法杖会{increase}{in}{power}{and}{in}{number}{of}{charges}
items.enDesc: This scroll will upgrade a single item, improving its quality. A wand will {increase}{in}{power}{and}{in}{number}{of}{charges}

zhConsts.TXT_LOOKS_BETTER: 你的%s现在看起来顺眼多了

items.zhDesc: 念出这张卷轴可以释放地牢亡魂的怒火，杀死当前楼层上的一切。嗯，几乎是一切。某些更强大的生物可能不受影响。
items.enDesc: Read this scroll to unleash the wrath of the dungeon spirits, killing everything on the current level. Well, almost everything. Some of the more powerful creatures may be not affected.

zhConsts.TXT_BLINDED: 失明时你无法阅读卷轴

enConsts.TXT_BLINDED: You can't read a scroll while blinded

items.zhDesc: 这只小小的天鹅绒口袋可以装下任意数量的种子。非常方便。
items.enDesc: This small velvet pouch allows you to store any number of seeds in it. Very convenient.

items.zhDesc: 它确实很短，只比匕首长几英寸。
items.enDesc: It is indeed quite short, just a few inches longer, than a dagger.

zhConsts.TXT_SELECT_WEAPON: 选择一件武器进行升级
zhConsts.TXT_REFORGED: 你重铸了短剑，用来升级你的%s
zhConsts.TXT_NOT_BOOMERANG: 你不能这样升级回旋镖

enConsts.TXT_REFORGED: you reforged the short sword to upgrade your %s
enConsts.TXT_NOT_BOOMERANG: you can't upgrade a boomerang this way

items.zhDesc: 星形的金属片带着剃刀般锋利的刃口，命中目标时伤害可观，而且能以极快的频率连续投掷。
items.enDesc: Star-shaped pieces of metal with razor-sharp blades do significant damage when they hit a target. They can be thrown at very high rate.

items.zhDesc: 这把钥匙看起来来头不小：钥匙头做成了骷髅的形状。大概能打开某扇来头不小的门。
items.enDesc: This key looks serious: its head is shaped like a skull. Probably it can open some serious door.

items.zhDesc: 一根纤细的木杆，顶端装着一截削尖的铁。
items.enDesc: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron.

items.zhDesc: 这柄锋利的钢制长刃闪着令人安心的寒光。
items.enDesc: The razor-sharp length of steel blade shines reassuringly.

items.zhDesc: 这把投掷用的斧头不算太重，但要发挥威力仍需要相当的力量。
items.enDesc: This throwing axe is not that heavy, but it still requires significant strength to be used effectively.

items.zhDesc: 这本磨损的皮面书并不算厚，但你莫名觉得能从中学到很多。不过要记住，读完这本书可能需要一些时间。
items.enDesc: This worn leather book is not that thick, but you feel somehow, that you can gather a lot from it. Remember though that reading this tome may require some time.

items.zhDesc: 在恶魔殿堂里这是不可或缺的道具，那地方以环境照明极差而臭名昭著。
items.enDesc: It's an indispensable item in The Demon Halls, which are notorious for their poor ambient lighting.

zhConsts.TXT_WOOD: 这根纤细的%s法杖摸上去暖暖的。谁知道使用它会发生什么？
zhConsts.TXT_DAMAGE: 把这支法杖当作近战武器时，它的平均伤害是每次 %d 点。
zhConsts.TXT_WEAPON: 你可以把这支法杖当作近战武器使用。
zhConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: 你对自己的%s已经足够熟悉了。

enConsts.TXT_WOOD: This thin %s wand is warm to the touch. Who knows what it will do when used?
enConsts.TXT_DAMAGE: When this wand is used as a melee weapon, its average damage is %d points per hit.
enConsts.TXT_WEAPON: You can use this wand as a melee weapon.
enConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: You are now familiar enough with your %s.

items.zhDesc: 这个细长的皮套是用某种异域动物的皮革制成的，可以紧凑地携带最多 {size} 支法杖。
items.enDesc: This slim holder is made of leather of some exotic animal. It allows to compactly carry up to {size} wands.

items.zhDesc: 这支法杖发出的紫光会让目标陷入狂乱，攻击它附近的随机生物。
items.enDesc: The purple light from this wand will make the target run amok attacking random creatures in its vicinity.

items.zhDesc: 当这支法杖的冲击击中墙壁（或其他固体障碍）时，会引发一场石崩，对受影响区域内的所有生物造成伤害并使其眩晕。
items.enDesc: When a discharge of this wand hits a wall (or any other solid obstacle) it causes an avalanche of stones, damaging and stunning all creatures in the affected area.

items.zhDesc: 这支法杖能让你朝选定方向传送。生物和实体障碍会阻挡传送。
items.enDesc: This wand will allow you to teleport in the chosen direction. Creatures and inanimate obstructions will block the teleportation.

items.zhDesc: 这支法杖射出一道毁灭性能量束，穿透它路径上的所有生物。命中的目标越多，对每一个造成的伤害就越高。
items.enDesc: This wand emits a beam of destructive energy, which pierces all creatures in its way. The more targets it hits, the more damage it inflicts to each of them.

items.zhDesc: 这支法杖会喷发阵阵魔法火焰，能点燃可燃地形，并灼伤被它击中的生物。
items.enDesc: This wand unleashes bursts of magical fire. It will ignite flammable terrain, and will damage and burn a creature it hits.

items.zhDesc: 这是一只魔法绵羊。它哪里魔法了？你杀不死它。它会一直站在那里，直到魔法般地消失，全程面无表情地反刍着。
items.enDesc: This is a magic sheep. What's so magical about it? You can't kill it. It will stand there until it magcially fades away, all the while chewing cud with a blank stare.

items.zhDesc: 这支法杖召来致命的电弧，对彼此靠近的数个生物造成伤害。
items.enDesc: This wand conjures forth deadly arcs of electricity, which deal damage to several creatures standing close to each other.

items.zhDesc: 这支法杖发射纯粹魔力凝聚的飞弹，对目标生物造成中等伤害。
items.enDesc: This wand launches missiles of pure magical energy, dealing moderate damage to a target creature.

zhConsts.TXT_SELECT_WAND: 选择一支法杖进行升级
zhConsts.TXT_DISENCHANTED: 你分解了魔法飞弹法杖，用它的精华来升级你的%s

enConsts.TXT_DISENCHANTED: you disenchanted the Wand of Magic Missile and used its essence to upgrade your %s

items.zhDesc: 这截扭曲木头喷出的邪恶冲击会给目标注入致命毒液。中毒的生物会持续受到伤害，直到效果结束。效果持续时间随法杖等级提高而延长。
items.enDesc: The vile blast of this twisted bit of wood will imbue its target with a deadly venom. A creature that is poisoned will suffer periodic damage until the effect ends. The duration of the effect increases with the level of the staff.

items.zhDesc: 这支实用法杖可以隔空取物，还能与敌人交换位置。它辐射出的魔力波会影响沿途所有格子，触发陷阱、踩倒高草、打开关着的门、关上开着的门。
items.enDesc: This utility wand can be used to grab objects from a distance and to switch places with enemies. Waves of magic force radiated from it will affect all cells on their way triggering traps, trampling high vegetation, opening closed doors and closing open ones.

zhConsts.TXT_YOU_NOW_HAVE: 你用魔法把%s送进了自己的背包

enConsts.TXT_YOU_NOW_HAVE: You have magically transported %s into your backpack

items.zhDesc: 「生命终结之处，新的生命总会开始生长……永恒的循环永不停息！」
items.enDesc: "When life ceases new life always begins to grow... The eternal cycle always remains!"

items.zhDesc: 这支法杖会让一个生物以平时一半的速度移动和攻击，直到效果结束。
items.enDesc: This wand will cause a creature to move and attack at half its ordinary speed until the effect ends

items.zhDesc: 这支法杖的一击会把一个生物违背其意愿地传送到当前楼层的某个随机位置。
items.enDesc: A blast from this wand will teleport a creature against its will to a random place on the current level.

items.zhDesc: 很少有生物能扛住这座由铅与钢堆成的高塔砸下的粉碎一击，但也只有最强壮的冒险者才能挥动它。
items.enDesc: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but only the strongest of adventurers can use it effectively.

items.zhDesc: 这套护甲看上去很笨重，却能让勇士朝指定位置施展「英勇跃击」，落地时震晕周围所有敌人。
items.enDesc: While this armor looks heavy, it allows a warrior to perform heroic leap towards a targeted location, slamming down to stun all neighbouring enemies.

zhConsts.TXT_NOT_WARRIOR: 只有勇士能使用这件护甲！

enConsts.TXT_NOT_WARRIOR: Only warriors can use this armor!

zhConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: 你对自己的%s已经足够熟悉，可以鉴定它了。它是%s。
zhConsts.TXT_INCOMPATIBLE: 不同种类魔法的相互作用抵消了这把武器上的附魔！

enConsts.TXT_IDENTIFY: You are now familiar enough with your %s to identify it. It is %s.
enConsts.TXT_INCOMPATIBLE: Interaction of different types of magic has negated the enchantment on this weapon!

items.zhDesc: 用配重石可以调整近战武器的平衡，提高它的攻速或命中。
items.enDesc: Using a weightstone, you can balance your melee weapon to increase its speed or accuracy.

mobs.zhDesc: 这些敏捷而顽强的洞顶居民能通过每一次成功的攻击回复生命，从而击败比自己大得多的对手。
mobs.enDesc: These brisk and tenacious inhabitants of cave domes may defeat much larger opponents by replenishing their health with each successful attack.

mobs.zhDesc: 蛮兵是所有豺狼人中体型最大、最强壮也最坚韧的。受到重伤时它们会陷入狂暴，对敌人造成更高的伤害。
mobs.enDesc: Brutes are the largest, strongest and toughest of all gnolls. When severely wounded, they go berserk, inflicting even more damage to their enemies.

mobs.zhDesc: 这些巨大的螃蟹位于下水道食物链的顶端。它们速度极快，厚重的外骨骼能扛住沉重的打击。
mobs.enDesc: These huge crabs are at the top of the food chain in the sewers. They are extremely fast and their thick exoskeleton can withstand heavy blows.

mobs.zhDesc: 这个生物外形酷似悲伤幽灵，却翻涌着黑暗。它的脸上挂着绝望的神情。
mobs.enDesc: This creature resembles the sad ghost, but it swirls with darkness. Its face bears an expression of despair.

mobs.zhDesc: 这台机器是矮人在几个世纪前造出来的。后来，矮人开始用魔像、元素、甚至恶魔来取代机器。这最终导致了他们文明的衰落。DM-300 之类的机器通常用于建筑和采矿，某些情况下也用于城防。
mobs.enDesc: This machine was created by the Dwarves several centuries ago. Later, Dwarves started to replace machines with golems, elementals and even demons. Eventually it led their civilization to the decline. The DM-300 and similar machines were typically used for construction and mining, and in some cases, for city defense.

mobs.zhDesc: 游荡的火元素是召唤强大存在的副产物。它们天性太过混乱，即便是最强大的恶魔学家也驾驭不了。
mobs.enDesc: Wandering fire elementals are a byproduct of summoning greater entities. They are too chaotic in their nature to be controlled by even the most powerful demonologist.

mobs.zhDesc: 这个恶魔的另一个名字叫「仇恨之球」，因为它一旦发现敌人，就会不顾一切地使用死亡凝视，常常连同伴都不顾，把他们一起重伤。
mobs.enDesc: One of this demon's other names is "orb of hatred", because when it sees an enemy, it uses its deathgaze recklessly, often ignoring its allies and wounding them.

mobs.zhDesc: 这只巨鼠比普通的同类大得多，周身笼罩着一股恶臭的云雾。
mobs.enDesc: This marsupial rat is much larger than a regular one. It is surrounded by a foul cloud.

mobs.zhDesc: 豺狼人是形似鬣狗的人形生物。它们栖居在下水道和地牢中，时不时上到地面劫掠。斥候是族群里的普通成员，没有蛮兵强壮，也没有萨满聪明。
mobs.enDesc: Gnolls are hyena-like humanoids. They dwell in sewers and dungeons, venturing up to raid the surface from time to time. Gnoll scouts are regular members of their pack, they are not as strong as brutes and not as intelligent as shamans.

mobs.zhDesc: 矮人试图把机械知识与新掌握的元素束缚之力结合起来。他们用大地之灵作为魔像机械躯体的「灵魂」，认为这是最容易控制的一种。尽管如此，仪式中最微小的失误仍可能引发失控。
mobs.enDesc: The Dwarves tried to combine their knowledge of mechanisms with their newfound power of elemental binding. They used spirits of earth as the "soul" for the mechanical bodies of golems, which were believed to be most controllable of all. Despite this, the tiniest mistake in the ritual could cause an outbreak.

mobs.zhDesc: 关于咕噜，人们所知甚少。它很可能根本算不上生物，而只是下水道里的一团物质，偶然获得了些许自由意志。
mobs.enDesc: Little known about The Goo. It's quite possible that it is not even a creature, but rather a conglomerate of substances from the sewers that gained rudiments of free will.

mobs.zhDesc: 末代矮人国王以对生死之道的深刻理解而闻名。他说服朝廷成员参加一场本应赋予他们永恒青春的仪式。到头来只有他一个人得到了——外带一支亡灵大军作为赠品。
mobs.enDesc: The last king of dwarves was known for his deep understanding of processes of life and death. He has persuaded members of his court to participate in a ritual, that should have granted them eternal youthfulness. In the end he was the only one, who got it - and an army of undead as a bonus.

mobs.zhDesc: 拟形怪是可以变成任意形状的魔法生物。在地牢里，它们几乎总是选择宝箱的形态，因为它们知道怎样才能勾引冒险者上钩。
mobs.enDesc: Mimics are magical creatures which can take any shape they wish. In dungeons they almost always choose a shape of a treasure chest, because they know how to beckon an adventurer.

mobs.zhDesc: 真正的描述即将推出！
mobs.enDesc: Real description is coming soon!

zhConsts.TXT_DIED: 你听到远处有什么东西死掉了

enConsts.TXT_DIED: You hear something died in the distance

mobs.zhDesc: 这些武僧是狂信者，誓死保护自己城市的秘密不被任何外来者窥探。他们不使用护甲和武器，只依靠徒手格斗的技艺。
mobs.enDesc: These monks are fanatics, who devoted themselves to protecting their city's secrets from all aliens. They don't use any armor or weapons, relying solely on the art of hand-to-hand combat.

enConsts.TXT_DISARM: %s has knocked the %s from your hands!

mobs.zhDesc: 这些肉食性鱼类并非地下水塘的原生物种。它们是被专门培育出来，守护被水淹没的藏宝库的。
mobs.enDesc: These carnivorous fish are not natural inhabitants of underground pools. They were bred specifically to protect flooded treasure vaults.

mobs.zhDesc: 有袋巨鼠攻击性强，但相当弱小，是下水道的常见居民。只有成群结队时它们才危险。
mobs.enDesc: Marsupial rats are aggressive, but rather weak denizens of the sewers. They can be dangerous only in big numbers.

mobs.zhDesc: 这些巨大的蛛形恶魔会不惜一切避免近战，从远处射出致残的锯齿尖刺。
mobs.enDesc: These huge arachnid-like demonic creatures avoid close combat by all means, firing crippling serrated spikes from long distances.

mobs.zhDesc: 最聪明的豺狼人能够掌握萨满法术。它们偏好战斗法术以弥补力量的不足，并且毫不迟疑地对那些质疑自己在族群中地位的人使用。
mobs.enDesc: The most intelligent gnolls can master shamanistic magic. Gnoll shamans prefer battle spells to compensate for lack of might, not hesitating to use them on those who question their status in a tribe.

mobs.zhDesc: 骷髅由倒霉的冒险者与地牢居民的尸骨拼成，被来自地底的邪恶魔法气息驱动。受到足够伤害后，它们会炸成一堆碎骨。
mobs.enDesc: Skeletons are composed of corpses bones from unlucky adventurers and inhabitants of the dungeon, animated by emanations of evil magic from the depths below. After they have been damaged enough, they disintegrate in an explosion of bones.

zhConsts.TXT_HERO_KILLED: 你被骨片的爆炸杀死了……

enConsts.TXT_HERO_KILLED: You were killed by the explosion of bones...

mobs.zhDesc: 这些毛茸茸的绿色洞窟蜘蛛会尽量避免正面战斗，宁愿远远等着，让被蛛网缠住的猎物慢慢死于它们的毒咬。
mobs.enDesc: These greenish furry cave spiders try to avoid direct combat, preferring to wait in the distance while their victim, entangled in the spinner's excreted cobweb, slowly dies from their poisonous bite.

mobs.zhDesc: 你会以为这只是地牢里又一尊丑陋的石像，但它发着红光的眼睛出卖了它。石像本身是石头做的，可它握着的_{weapon.name}_看上去是真的。
mobs.enDesc: You would think that it's just another ugly statue of this dungeon, but its red glowing eyes give itself away. While the statue itself is made of stone, the _{weapon.name}_, it's wielding, looks real.

mobs.zhDesc: 魅魔是外形如同妖艳少女（略带哥特味道）的恶魔。魅魔能用魔法魅惑英雄，使其在魅惑消退前无法攻击任何东西。
mobs.enDesc: The succubi are demons that look like seductive (in a slightly gothic way) girls. Using its magic, the succubus can charm a hero, who will become unable to attack anything until the charm wears off.

mobs.zhDesc: 致命的蝇群愤怒地嗡嗡作响。每一次非魔法攻击都会把它分裂成两团更小、但同样危险的蝇群。
mobs.enDesc: The deadly swarm of flies buzzes angrily. Every non-magical attack will split it into two smaller but equally dangerous swarms.

mobs.zhDesc: 天狗是古代刺客组织「天狗」的成员。这些刺客以大量使用手里剑和陷阱而闻名。
mobs.enDesc: Tengu are members of the ancient assassins clan, which is also called Tengu. These assassins are noted for extensive use of shuriken and traps.

zhConsts.TXT_CARRIES: %s 正带着一个 _%s_。显然是偷来的。

mobs.zhDesc: 当矮人的兴趣从工程转向奥术时，术士们掌握了这座城市的权力。他们从元素魔法起步，但很快就转向了恶魔学与死灵术。
mobs.enDesc: When dwarves' interests have shifted from engineering to arcane arts, warlocks have come to power in the city. They started with elemental magic, but soon switched to demonology and necromancy.

mobs.zhDesc: 怨灵是罪人的复仇之魂，其坟墓或墓穴遭到了侵扰。作为灵体，普通武器很难击中它。
mobs.enDesc: A wraith is a vengeful spirit of a sinner, whose grave or tomb was disturbed. Being an ethereal entity, it is very hard to hit with a regular weapon.

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: Yog-Dzewa 是一位古神，来自混沌领域的强大存在。一个世纪前，古代矮人勉强打赢了对它那支恶魔军队的战争，却无法杀死这位神明本身。于是他们把它囚禁在自己城市下方的殿堂里，以为它已经衰弱到永远无法再起。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: Yog-Dzewa is an Old God, a powerful entity from the realms of chaos. A century ago, the ancient dwarves barely won the war against its army of demons, but were unable to kill the god itself. Instead, they then imprisoned it in the halls below their city, believing it to be too weak to rise ever again.

npcs.zhDesc: 尽管个头很小，金色蜜蜂却会凶狠地保护自己的主人。不过它们活不长。
npcs.enDesc: Despite their small size, golden bees tend to protect their master fiercely. They don't live long though.

npcs.zhDesc: 这个巨魔铁匠长得和所有巨魔一样：又高又瘦，皮肤无论颜色还是质感都像石头。他正摆弄着一套小得不成比例的工具。
npcs.enDesc: This troll blacksmith looks like all trolls look: he is tall and lean, and his skin resembles stone in both color and texture. The troll blacksmith is tinkering with unproportionally small tools.

zhConsts.TXT_GOLD_1: 嘿，人类！想不想做点有用的事，嗯？拿上这把鹤嘴锄，给我挖点 _暗金矿石_，_15 块_就够了。你问我要怎么付你钱？你可真贪……好吧好吧，我没钱付你，但我可以帮你打点铁器。算你走运，这一带只有我一个铁匠。
zhConsts.TXT_BLOOD_1: 嘿，人类！想不想做点有用的事，嗯？拿上这把鹤嘴锄，_杀一只蝙蝠_，我要把血涂在锄头上。你问我要怎么付你钱？你可真贪……好吧好吧，我没钱付你，但我可以帮你打点铁器。算你走运，这一带只有我一个铁匠。
zhConsts.TXT2: 你在跟我开玩笑吗？我的鹤嘴锄呢？！
zhConsts.TXT3: 暗金矿石，15 块。说真的，这有那么难吗？
zhConsts.TXT4: 我说过我要锄头上沾着蝙蝠的血。快点动手！
zhConsts.TXT_COMPLETED: 哦，你回来了……迟到总比不到好。
zhConsts.TXT_LOOKS_BETTER: 你的%s现在看起来顺眼多了

enConsts.TXT_GOLD_1:
Hey human! Wanna be useful, eh? Take dis pickaxe and mine me some _dark gold ore_, _15 pieces_ should be enough. What do you mean, how am I gonna pay? You greedy...
Ok, ok, I don't have money to pay, but I can do some smithin' for you. Consider yourself lucky, I'm the only blacksmith around.
enConsts.TXT_BLOOD_1:
Hey human! Wanna be useful, eh? Take dis pickaxe and _kill a bat_ wit' it, I need its blood on the head. What do you mean, how am I gonna pay? You greedy...
Ok, ok, I don't have money to pay, but I can do some smithin' for you. Consider yourself lucky, I'm the only blacksmith around.
enConsts.TXT2: Are you kiddin' me? Where is my pickaxe?!
enConsts.TXT3: Dark gold ore. 15 pieces. Seriously, is it dat hard?
enConsts.TXT4: I said I need bat blood on the pickaxe. Chop chop!
enConsts.TXT_COMPLETED: Oh, you have returned... Better late dan never.

npcs.zhDesc: 幽灵几乎看不见。它像是一团无形的光斑，上面浮着一张哀伤的脸。
npcs.enDesc: The ghost is barely visible. It looks like a shapeless spot of faint light with a sorrowful face.

zhConsts.TXT_ROSE1: 你好啊，冒险者……曾经我也像你一样——强壮而自信……可现在我已经死了……但我离不开这个地方……除非找回我的 _干枯的玫瑰_……它对我非常重要……有只怪物把它从我身上偷走了……
zhConsts.TXT_ROSE2: 求你了……帮帮我……_找到那朵玫瑰_……
zhConsts.TXT_ROSE3: 对！对！！！就是它！请把它交给我！你可以从这些东西里挑一件，也许它们能在你的旅途中派上用场……
zhConsts.TXT_RAT1: 你好啊，冒险者……曾经我也像你一样——强壮而自信……可现在我已经死了……但我离不开这个地方……除非报了这仇……杀掉那只夺走我性命的 _恶臭巨鼠_……
zhConsts.TXT_RAT2: 求你了……帮帮我……_宰掉那头怪物_……
zhConsts.TXT_RAT3: 太好了！那只丑陋的怪物死了，我终于可以安息了……请从这些东西里挑一件吧，也许它们能在你的旅途中派上用场……
zhConsts.TXT_CURSE1: 你好啊，冒险者……曾经我也像你一样——强壮而自信……可现在我已经死了……但我离不开这个地方，我被一个可怕的诅咒束缚着……求你了……帮帮我……_破除这个诅咒_……
zhConsts.TXT_CURSE2: 谢谢你，%s！诅咒解除了，我终于可以安息了……请从这些东西里挑一件吧，也许它们能在你的旅途中派上用场……

enConsts.TXT_ROSE1: Hello adventurer... Once I was like you - strong and confident... And now I'm dead... But I can't leave this place... Not until I have my _dried rose_... It's very important to me... Some monster stole it from my body...
enConsts.TXT_ROSE3: Yes! Yes!!! This is it! Please give it to me! And you can take one of these items, maybe they will be useful to you in your journey...
enConsts.TXT_RAT1: Hello adventurer... Once I was like you - strong and confident... And now I'm dead... But I can't leave this place... Not until I have my revenge... Slay the _fetid rat_, that has taken my life...
enConsts.TXT_RAT3: Yes! The ugly creature is slain and I can finally rest... Please take one of these items, maybe they will be useful to you in your journey...
enConsts.TXT_CURSE1: Hello adventurer... Once I was like you - strong and confident... And now I'm dead... But I can't leave this place, as I am bound by a horrid curse... Please... Help me... _Destroy the curse_...
enConsts.TXT_CURSE2: Thank you, %s! The curse is broken and I can finally rest... Please take one of these items, maybe they will be useful to you in your journey...
enConsts.TXT_YES: Yes, I will do it for you

npcs.zhDesc: 小恶魔是低等恶魔。它们的力量和魔法天赋都不出众，但相当聪明而且善于交际。许多小恶魔更喜欢和非恶魔住在一起。
npcs.enDesc: Imps are lesser demons. They are notable for neither their strength nor their magic talent, but they are quite smart and sociable. Many imps prefer to live among non-demons.

zhConsts.TXT_GOLEMS1: 你是冒险者吗？我最喜欢冒险者了！只要有东西需要被干掉，找他们准没错。{if}{something}{needs}{to}{be}{killed.}{Am}{I}{right}{For}{a}{bounty}{of}{course}

zhConsts.TXT_GOLEMS2: 你的魔像狩猎之旅进展如何？

enConsts.TXT_MONKS1: Are you an adventurer? I love adventurers! You can always rely on them {if}{something}{needs}{to}{be}{killed.}{Am}{I}{right}{For}{a}{bounty}{of}{course}
enConsts.TXT_GOLEMS2: How is your golem safari going?

npcs.zhDesc: 小恶魔是低等恶魔。它们的力量与魔法天赋都不出众，但相当聪明而且善于交际，许多小恶魔更喜欢在非恶魔中间生活、做生意。
npcs.enDesc: Imps are lesser demons. They are notable for neither their strength nor their magic talent. But they are quite smart and sociable, and many of imps prefer to live and do business among non-demons.

npcs.zhDesc: 这个幻象和你非常相似，只是颜色更苍白，而且会微微抽搐。
npcs.enDesc: This illusion bears a close resemblance to you, but it's paler and twitches a little.

npcs.zhDesc: 这只老鼠比普通有袋巨鼠稍大一些，头上戴着一顶小小的王冠。
npcs.enDesc: This rat is a little bigger than a regular marsupial rat and it's wearing a tiny crown on its head.

npcs.zhDesc: 这个矮胖的家伙看上去更适合待在大城市的商业区，而不是地牢里。看看他的价格，你就明白他为什么偏爱在这儿做生意了。
npcs.enDesc: This stout guy looks more appropriate for a trade district in some large city than for a dungeon. His prices explain why he prefers to do business here.

npcs.zhDesc: 这位上了年纪却依然硬朗的绅士，脸上带着一丝困惑的神情。他被一层魔法护盾保护着。
npcs.enDesc: This old but hale gentleman wears a slightly confused expression. He is protected by a magic shield.

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: 一被触碰，梦草就会分泌出一片闪闪发光的迷乱气体。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: Upon touching a Dreamweed it secretes a glittering cloud of confusing gas.

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: 当有生物触碰地根草时，它的根须会在其周围形成一层天然护甲。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: When a creature touches an Earthroot, its roots create a kind of natural armor around it.

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: 触碰凋零叶会把生物传送到当前楼层的某个随机位置。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: Touching a Fadeleaf will teleport any creature to a random place on the current level.

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: 任何东西一碰到火焰花，它就会爆出火焰。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: When something touches a Firebloom, it bursts into flames.

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: 一被触碰，冰帽花就会喷出花粉，把周围的一切都冻住。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: Upon touching an Icecap excretes a pollen, which freezes everything in its vicinity.

zhConsts.TXT_INFO: 把这颗种子扔到你想让 %s 生长的地方。  %s

enConsts.TXT_INFO:

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: 这种灌木的浆果，尝起来是甜美的、甜美的死亡。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: Berries of this shrub taste like sweet, sweet death.

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: 悲伤苔其实是一种花（不是苔藓），花瓣如剃刀般锋利，上面覆着致命的毒液。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: A Sorrowmoss is a flower (not a moss) with razor-sharp petals, coated with a deadly venom.

zhConsts.TXT_DESC: 太阳草以其汁液的治愈功效而闻名。

enConsts.TXT_DESC: Sungrass is renowned for its sap's healing properties.

zhConsts.TEXT: 在你之前，各式各样的英雄都曾闯入这座地牢。有些人带着财宝和魔法神器归来，大多数人则从此音讯全无。但至今没有一个人成功取回耶诺之护符——据说它被藏在地牢的最深处。  你认为自己已经准备好迎接这个挑战，更重要的是，你感觉到命运正在对你微笑。是时候开启属于你自己的冒险了！

enConsts.TEXT:
Many heroes of all kinds ventured into the Dungeon before you. Some of them have returned with treasures and magical artifacts, most have never been heard of since. But none have succeeded in retrieving the Amulet of Yendor, which is told to be hidden in the depths of the Dungeon.

You consider yourself ready for the challenge, but most importantly, you feel that fortune smiles on you. It's time to start your own adventure!

extra.SEWERS: 地牢就位于城市的正下方，它最上面几层实际上就是城市的下水道系统。名义上属于城市的一部分，这几层并不算太危险。没人会说这里安全，但至少你还不必应付邪恶的魔法。
extra.PRISON: 许多年前，这里建起了一座关押最危险罪犯的地下监狱。在当时看来这是个非常聪明的主意，因为这地方确实极难逃脱。但很快，黑暗的瘴气开始从下方渗透进来，把囚犯和看守都逼疯了。最终监狱被废弃，不过有些犯人被锁在这里，再也没能出去。
extra.CAVES: 延伸在被废弃监狱下方的洞窟人烟稀少。它们埋得太深，城市无力开发；矿产又太贫瘠，矮人看不上眼。过去，在两大势力之间的商路上曾有过一处贸易哨站，但自从矮人都城衰败后，它也随之消亡。如今这里只有无处不在的豺狼人和地下动物栖居。
extra.METROPOLIS: 矮人都城曾是最伟大的矮人城邦。鼎盛时期，矮人的机械化大军成功击退了古神与其恶魔军团的入侵。但据说，凯旋的战士们带回了腐化的种子——那场胜利，正是这个地下王国终结的开端。
extra.HALLS:
过去，这几层是都城的郊区。与古神一战代价惨重，矮人元气大伤，无力清除残留的恶魔。渐渐地，恶魔收紧了对这里的控制，如今它被称作恶魔殿堂。

能有幸深入到这里的冒险者寥寥无几……
